storyCards.headline: Imagine: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
John Lennon/plastic Ono Band's "Imagine" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Imagine was released in 1971.

"Imagine" by John Lennon/plastic Ono Band.
